sections.shortTitle: Sindh Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges First Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1989
ACT VI OF 1989
SINDH SPEAKER'S
AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis‑B‑5/89,
dated 17‑5‑1989.‑‑The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th April, 1989 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd May, 1989 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975, in section 6, in subsection (2)‑‑
(i) the words
and commas "the Speaker shall, in addition," shall be deleted;

Deputy Speaker" shall be inserted.
